lead_editorial.title: Tel $116 ke paar, aur Hormuz mein baaroodi surangein — Bharat ko ab 'intezaar karo' se aage ki niti chahiye
lead_editorial.summary: Hormuz mein tankeron par hamle aur Saudi tel thikaanon par Houthi daavon ne kachche tel ko phir ubaal par la diya hai. Bharat ke liye yeh sirf bazaar ki kahani nahi, aayaat bill, mehngaai aur urja suraksha ka sawaal hai.
body: Shukravaar subah Brent kachcha tel lagbhag $115.7 prati barrel par tha aur Business Recorder ki Reuters-aadharit report ke mutabik October mein ismein kareeb 14% ki badhat ki raah bani hui hai. WTI April ke baad pehli baar $100 ke upar mahine ka ant karne ki taraf hai. Wajah saaf hai: Iran ke IRGC ka daava ki Hormuz ke 'anadhikrit' dakshini raaste par teen tanker baaroodi surangon se takraakar jale, aur Houthiyon ka daava ki unhone Ras Tanura, Rabigh aur Abqaiq jaise Saudi thikaanon ko nishaana banaaya.

Bharat apni zaroorat ka bada hissa aayaat karta hai, isliye har dollar ki badhat seedhe aayaat bill, rupaye aur aakhir mein aam aadmi ki jeb tak pahunchti hai. HDFC Sky ki market report ne bhi Shukravaar ko kaha ki tel ki keemat ne Bharat ke import bill ko lekar chinta badhaayi. Yeh bhi gaur karne laayak hai ki Indian Oil ne isi din Rs 21,630 crore ka record-star munafa dikhaaya — yaani refining kampaniyon ke khaate fil-haal behtar hain, lekin graahak aur arthvyavastha par dabaav alag cheez hai.

Kootneeti ke morche par halki ummeed hai: America ke doot Tom Barrack ne kaha ki Washington aur Tehran 'timeout' ke 'bahut kareeb' hain, Qatar ke madhyasth phir Tehran pahunche hain. Lekin Iran ke Speaker Ghalibaf ki saat sharton aur dono pakshon ke beech 'pehle kya' ke vivaad se saaf hai ki raasta abhi lamba hai. Aise mein sirf samjhaute ke bharose baithna jokhim bhara hai.

Hamari raay mein Bharat ko teen kaam tezi se karne chahiye: kachche tel ke strategic bhandaar aur supply ke vikalpon ko aur faila kar rakhna, Hormuz se guzarne waale Bharatiya jahaazon aur naavikon ki suraksha par khuli aur niyamit jaankari dena, aur keemat ke jhatke ka bojh kaise baanta jaayega is par paardarshi niti rakhna. Sankat ka ant humare haath mein nahi, lekin uski taiyaari zaroor hai.

stories.title: Banaskantha se PM Modi ne jaari ki PM-KISAN ki 24vi kist: 9.34 crore kisaan parivaaron ko Rs 18,680 crore; bole — 'jeevan ke antim kshan tak' seva karunga
stories.summary: Gujarat ke Bhildi mein 'PM Kisan Utsav Diwas' par Pradhan Mantri ne kist jaari ki, Rs 14,000 crore ki pariyojnaaon ki shuruaat ki aur Opposition par apratyaksh nishaana saadha.
body: Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi ne Shukravaar ko Gujarat ke Banaskantha zile ke Bhildi se PM-KISAN yojana ki 24vi kist jaari ki. Hans India (IANS) ki report ke mutabik is kist mein desh bhar ke 9.34 crore se zyada kisaan parivaaron ko Rs 18,680 crore se adhik ki rakam bheji gayi, jismein Gujarat ke 52.33 lakh se zyada parivaaron ke hisse Rs 1,051 crore se adhik aaye. Pehli 23 kiston mein 11 crore se zyada parivaaron ko Rs 4.47 lakh crore se adhik mil chuke hain.

Is mauke par Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre (Rs 328.77 crore) ka udghaatan hua aur Banas Dairy ke Tharad aur Radhanpur mein do compressed biogas plant ki neev rakhi gayi. Siasat ki report ke mutabik PM ne kul Rs 14,000 crore ki pariyojnaaon ki shuruaat ki aur kaha ki vaishvik anishchitata mein khaad ki keemat badhne ke bawajood sarkaar ne uska bojh kisaanon par nahi daala.

Congress adhyaksh Mallikarjun Kharge ki haaliya tippani ke kuch din baad PM ne kaha ki woh 'jeevan ke antim kshan tak' janta ki seva karte rahenge. Unhone Rahul Gandhi ke 2017 ke 'aloo se sona' waale bayaan ka zikr karte hue kaha ki Banaskantha ke kisaan pehle se yeh kar rahe hain. PM ne yeh daava bhi kiya ki Iran yuddh ke baad khaad aur LPG ki kami ki afwaahein unki chhavi kharaab karne ke liye failaayi gayin. Shanivaar 31 October ko woh Ekta Nagar mein Rashtriya Ekta Diwas samaaroh mein shaamil honge.

stories.title: Baarish ne roka INDIA bloc ka CEC Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaaf 'public impeachment'; ab Shanivaar 2:30 baje, 1 November ko Ramlila Maidan tak 'Chalo Dilli'
stories.summary: SIR mein kathit gadbadiyon ko lekar Opposition ka pratikaatmak virodh Kharge ke ghar hona tha; Rahul Gandhi bole — 'yeh ek hi virodh hai'.
body: Opposition ke INDIA bloc ne Mukhya Chunav Ayukt Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaaf Shukravaar ko hone waala pratikaatmak 'public impeachment' Delhi mein baarish ke chalte Shanivaar 31 October dopahar 2:30 baje tak taal diya. Congress ke sanchaar prabhaari Jairam Ramesh ne X par nayi tareekh ka elaan kiya. Rahul Gandhi ne kaha ki buzurg netaaon ka baarish mein baithna asahaj hota, isliye sahmati se yeh faisla liya gaya.

ThePrint ki report ke mutabik karyakram 10 Rajaji Marg par Mallikarjun Kharge ke awaas par hoga, jiski adhyakshta poorv Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar karengi; Kharge prastaav rakhenge aur Rahul Gandhi samaapan karenge. Taiyaari baithak mein TMC, SP, Shiv Sena (UBT), CPI(M), CPI, RJD aur RSP ke neta maujood the. Opposition ka aarop hai ki matdaata soochi ke Special Intensive Revision (SIR) mein gadbadi hui; woh CEC ka istifa maang raha hai. Chunav Aayog ki taraf se in aaropon par is report mein koi pratikriya darj nahi hai.

Rahul Gandhi ne Ravivaar 1 November ko Ramlila Maidan tak 'Chalo Dilli' march mein har kisi ko shaamil hone ki apeel ki. India TV ki report ke mutabik Delhi Police ne rally ko subah 10 se shaam 5 baje tak sharton ke saath anumati di hai, jismein bhadkaau bhaashan aur raat mein rukne par rok shaamil hai. BJP ne iske jawaab mein 'Save Democracy, Remove Anarchy' rallies tez ki hain aur Opposition ke virodh ki timing par sawaal uthaaya hai.

editorial.title: Chunav Aayog par bharosa sabse keemti poonji hai — aaropon ka jawaab sadak ki ladaai nahi, paardarshi data hai
body: CEC ke khilaaf 'public impeachment' kanooni prakriya nahi, ek raajnitik pradarshan hai, aur Opposition ise isi roop mein pesh kar raha hai. Loktantra mein virodh ka haq hai, lekin SIR jaisi bade paimaane ki prakriya par lagaaye gaye aaropon ki asli kasauti saboot hain — kitne naam kate, kyon kate, aur kis aadhaar par.

Hamari raay mein Chunav Aayog ke liye sabse achha jawaab yahi hoga ki woh rajya-vaar aur kshetra-vaar aankde, apatti ke maamle aur unke nipataare ki jaankari khule taur par saamne rakhe. Aayog ki chuppi ya sirf raajnitik pratikriya donon hi sandeh ko badhaate hain. Waise hi Opposition ki zimmedaari hai ki woh 'vote chori' jaise gambhir shabdon ke saath thos udaaharan bhi de, taaki bahas naaron se aage badhe.

stories.title: Hormuz mein tankeron par hamle, Saudi tel thikaanon par Houthi daave aur Makkah ke paas drone giraaya gaya: Khaadi mein tanaav phir charam par
stories.summary: IRGC ka daava — 'anadhikrit' raaste par teen tanker surangon se takraaye; UKMTO ne Oman ke paas ek tanker par projectile hamle ki pushti ki.
body: Iran ke Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) ne daava kiya ki pichhle 24 ghanton mein Hormuz ke dakshini raaste — jise Tehran 'anadhikrit' maanta hai — par teen tanker baaroodi surangon se takraakar jale. AFP ke hawaale se Business Recorder ke mutabik Iranian sena ne ek chauthe tanker mein bhi aag lagne ki baat kahi. In daavon ki swatantra pushti nahi hui hai; Britain ki UKMTO ne sirf Oman ke Khasab ke paas ek tanker par 'agyaat projectile' se hamle aur ek dhow ke doobne ki pushti ki, kisi ko zimmedaar nahi thehraaya.

Iske saath hi Yemen ke Houthiyon ne daava kiya ki unhone Saudi Arab ke Ras Tanura aur Rabigh refinery tatha Abqaiq mein Aramco ke thikaane par hamla kiya. Gulf News ke mutabik Saudi netritv waale gathbandhan ne Shukravaar ko Makkah kshetra mein ek Houthi drone ko maar giraane aur Guruvaar ko Riyadh ki taraf daage gaye do ballistic missile rokne ki baat kahi, jinke malbe se ek vyakti ko maamooli chot aayi.

Kootneeti ke morche par America ke doot Tom Barrack ne kaha ki Washington aur Tehran 'timeout' par sahmati ke kareeb hain, jabki Iran ke Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf ne kaha ki pehle Tehran ki saat shartein poori hon. Qatar ke madhyasth phir Tehran pahunche hain; Iran ko JD Vance ka khat mila hai lekin abhi jawaab nahi diya gaya. Washington pehle nuclear mudde par baat chahta hai, jabki Tehran pehle bandargaahon ki naakebandi aur tel pratibandh hatwaana chahta hai.

stories.title: Pentagon ke hataaye gaye planner Lt Gen Brett Sylvia par Iran-Ukraine ki gupt jaankari leak karne ka aarop; Axios ki report — maamla Justice Department ko
stories.summary: Internal jaanch report ke mutabik general ne do patrakaaron ko classified jaankari dene ki baat maani; yeh daava jaanch dastavezon aur anaam adhikaariyon par aadhaarit hai.
body: Gulf News ne Axios ke hawaale se bataaya ki Pentagon ke poorv sainya planner Army Lt Gen Brett Sylvia ne ek aantarik jaanch mein kathit taur par maana ki unhone Iran aur Ukraine se judi classified jaankari do patrakaaron ko di. Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth ne unhe Joint Chiefs ke strategy, plans aur policy daftar ke nideshak pad se hata diya tha.

CBS News aur AP ki reporton ke mutabik maamla Justice Department ko bheja gaya hai. Dhyaan rahe ki yeh sweekaarokti jaanch ke records aur anaam adhikaariyon ke hawaale se saamne aayi hai — koi saarvajanik plea ya adaalati faisla abhi nahi hua hai, aur General Sylvia ki taraf se koi saarvajanik bayaan report mein darj nahi hai.

editorial.title: Yuddh ke dhundh mein har daava khabar nahi hota — Hormuz par satyaapan zaroori hai
body: Hormuz se aa rahi khabron mein ek pattern dikhta hai: IRGC teen ya chaar tankeron ke jalne ki baat karta hai, jabki UKMTO jaisi swatantra agency sirf ek tanker aur ek dhow ki ghatna ki pushti karti hai. Dono pakshon ke apne prachaar-hit hain, aur aise mein media aur sarkaaron dono ko daave aur pushti ka fark saaf rakhna chahiye.

Hamari raay mein Bharat jaise deshon ke liye, jinke naavik in jahaazon par kaam karte hain, sabse zaroori hai ki nau-sena aur shipping mantralaya apne naagrikon se judi har ghatna ki tez aur satyaapit jaankari dein. Afwaahon par chalne waale bazaar aur bechain parivaar, dono ke liye sahi soochna hi sabse badi raahat hai.

stories.title: IT aur pharma ke dum par Sensex 308 ank chadhkar 74,460 par, Nifty phir 23,000 ke paar; lekin smallcap 1.8% fisla
stories.summary: Lagaataar doosre din badhat, par bazaar ki chaudai kamzor: 2,862 share gire, sirf 1,311 chadhe. Trent aur IndiGo top gainer.
body: HDFC Sky ki closing report ke mutabik Shukravaar ko Sensex 308.49 ank (0.42%) badhkar 74,459.53 par aur Nifty 50 116.35 ank (0.51%) chadhkar 23,053.10 par band hua. Nifty IT 2.3% aur Nifty Pharma 1.8% chadha, jabki consumer durables, PSU bank, energy aur media sooch-kaank 1% se zyada gire. Nifty Midcap 0.8% aur Smallcap 1.8% neeche rahe — yaani badhat kuch bade sharon tak seemit rahi.

Nifty mein Trent (+5.44%) sabse aage raha, jisne September timaahi mein munafe mein 23% badhat dikhaayi; IndiGo (+4.33%) ghaata kam hone se chadha, Infosys 3.36% aur Apollo Hospitals 3.02% upar rahe. Shriram Finance, M&M, Adani Ports, Adani Enterprises aur Coal India girne waalon mein the. Kamzor margin ke baad Suzlon lagbhag 7.9% fisla.

Brent kachcha tel Houthi hamlon ki khabron ke baad lagbhag 1% chadhkar $116.1 prati barrel tak pahuncha, jisse Bharat ke tel aayaat bill ko lekar chinta badhi. Guruvaar ko FPIs ne Rs 944 crore ke share beche, jabki gharelu sansthaanon ne Rs 1,924 crore ki kharidaari ki. (Yeh jaankari sirf soochna ke liye hai, nivesh salaah nahi.)

stories.title: Indian Oil ka Q2 munafa 184% uchhalkar Rs 21,630 crore; pichhli timaahi ke ghaate se zabardast vaapsi
stories.summary: Revenue 30% badhkar Rs 2.63 lakh crore; H1 mein LPG under-recovery ke liye Rs 7,243 crore ka sarkaari muavza bhi khaaton mein darj.
body: Sarkaari tel company Indian Oil Corporation (IOC) ne 30 September ko khatm timaahi mein Rs 21,630.03 crore ka standalone shuddh munafa darj kiya, jo pichhle saal ki isi timaahi ke Rs 7,610.45 crore se 184% zyada hai. Free Press Journal ki report ke mutabik operations se aay 30% badhkar Rs 2,62,935.58 crore rahi. Pehli timaahi (Q1 FY27) mein company ko Rs 2,661.37 crore ka ghaata hua tha.

Petroleum products segment ka munafa Rs 24,935 crore raha, jo saal bhar pehle Rs 11,269 crore tha. Company ne pehli chhamaahi mein gharelu LPG ki under-recovery ke badle Rs 7,243.02 crore ka sarkaari muavza bhi darj kiya. Auditors ne yeh bhi bataaya ki board mein swatantra aur non-executive directors ki nirdhaarit sankhya poori nahi hai, jiske chalte Audit Committee samet kuch zaroori samitiyaan band hain.
Usi din GAIL ne bhi munafa doguna se zyada hokar Rs 4,650 crore hone ki report di, Indian Masterminds ke mutabik.

editorial.title: Index hare, par zyaadatar share laal — bazaar ki 'patli' badhat ko samajhna zaroori
body: Shukravaar ko Nifty 23,000 ke paar laut aaya, lekin har ek chadhte share ke muqaable do se zyada share gire. Jab badhat kuch heavyweights tak simat jaati hai, to index ki tasveer poore bazaar ka haal nahi batati.

Hamari raay mein yeh samay suni-sunaai 'tips' ke peechhe bhaagne ka nahi, balki kampaniyon ke nateejon aur kachche tel jaise bahari jokhimon ko dhyaan se dekhne ka hai. Trent aur IndiGo jaise sharon mein tezi nateejon par aayi, afwaahon par nahi — aur yahi farq lambi avadhi mein maayne rakhta hai. Kisi bhi nivesh faisle se pehle apne salaahkar se baat karein.

stories.title: Eden Park mein Glenn Phillips ka 49 gend par 107 run ka toofan, Duffy ke 4 wicket; New Zealand ne India ko 87 run se haraaya, clean sweep ka sapna toota
stories.summary: NZ ne 259/7 banaaye, India 172/9 tak hi pahuncha; series ab 3-1, aakhri T20I 1 November ko Hamilton mein.
body: Auckland ke Eden Park mein chauthe T20I mein India ne toss jeetkar pehle gendbaazi chuni, lekin Glenn Phillips ne 49 gend par 107 run (6 chauke, 10 chhakke) thokkar New Zealand ko 20 over mein 259/7 tak pahuncha diya. Business Standard ki report ke mutabik jawaab mein India 9 wicket par 172 run hi bana saka aur 87 run se haara.

Jacob Duffy ne 4 over mein 23 run dekar 4 wicket liye. India ki taraf se Tilak Varma 35 gend par 35 run banaakar naabaad rahe; Naman Dhir ne 13 gend par 28, Abhishek Sharma ne 15 gend par 27 aur Shreyas Iyer ne 11 gend par 22 run banaaye. Pichhle match mein shatak lagaane waale Abhishek is baar badi pari nahi khel sake.

India series pehle hi 3-0 se jeet chuka tha, isliye yeh haar series par asar nahi daalti, par clean sweep ki ummeed khatm ho gayi. Paanchva aur aakhri T20I 1 November ko Hamilton ke Seddon Park mein khela jaayega.

stories.title: 'Star Trek' ke Captain Picard aur 'X-Men' ke Professor X, Sir Patrick Stewart ka 86 saal ki umr mein nidhan
stories.summary: Royal Shakespeare Company ke diggaj kalaakaar ne Los Angeles mein aakhri saans li; Filmibeat ki report ke mutabik woh lambe samay se Alzheimer's aur Lewy body dementia se jujh rahe the.
body: Hollywood aur British theatre ke diggaj abhineta Sir Patrick Stewart ka 86 saal ki umr mein nidhan ho gaya. CNN, Variety, Deadline aur Hollywood Reporter samet kai antarrashtriya media sansthaanon ne unke nidhan ki khabar di hai. Filmibeat ki report ke mutabik unhone Los Angeles mein apne ghar par aakhri saans li aur woh lambe samay se Alzheimer's aur Lewy body dementia se peedit the; parivaar ka aupchaarik bayaan is report mein nahi hai.

Stewart 'Star Trek: The Next Generation' (1987–1994) mein Captain Jean-Luc Picard aur X-Men filmon mein Professor Charles Xavier ke kirdaar se duniya bhar mein mashhoor hue. Woh 1966 se 1982 tak Royal Shakespeare Company ke sadasya rahe aur 60 se zyada productions mein kaam kiya. 2010 mein unhe naatya kala mein yogdaan ke liye knighthood mila; unke naam do Laurence Olivier Awards aur ek Grammy bhi hain.

stories.title: 'Jailer 2' ne Bharat mein Rs 500 crore gross ka aankda paar kiya; teesre hafte bhi box office par pakad mazboot
stories.summary: Sacnilk ke hawaale se Filmibeat ki report — kul gross Rs 502.65 crore, net Rs 429.55 crore.
body: Rajinikanth ki 'Jailer 2' ne Bharat mein Rs 500 crore gross ka aankda paar kar liya hai. Filmibeat ne Sacnilk ke shuruaati aankdon ke hawaale se bataaya ki teesre hafte mein film ne report kiye gaye din Rs 5.9 crore kamaaye aur iska kul gross Rs 502.65 crore tatha net Rs 429.55 crore pahunch gaya.

Film pehle hi Kerala mein Rs 72.85 crore gross ke saath 'Baahubali 2' ka record tod chuki hai. Isi beech, Filmibeat ki report ke mutabik Priyanka Chopra Jonas Oscar-qualified Bharatiya short film 'We Were Here' se executive producer ke roop mein judi hain, jise Pranav Bhasin ne nirdeshit kiya hai.

editorial.title: Ek haar se series ki chamak feeki nahi hoti — par 259 run ka sabak gendbaazon ke liye zaroori hai
body: 3-0 ki badhat ke baad Eden Park ki haar ko zyada tool dena theek nahi. Chhote maidaan aur Phillips jaisi pari ke saamne kisi bhi team ki gendbaazi bikhar sakti hai.

Phir bhi, hamari raay mein 259 run lutaana is baat ka sanket hai ki death overs aur chhote maidaanon ki ranneeti par kaam baaki hai. Hamilton ka aakhri match naye gendbaazon ko aazmaane aur series ko 4-1 se jeetkar khatm karne ka achha mauka hai.
